facts.claim: Anand Town had a population of 10,010 in 1901.
The town had 2 ginning factories, 3 dispensaries, and 5 schools.
facts.quote: 2 ginning factories, 3 dispensaries, and 5 schools (4 for boys and one for girls)

facts.claim: The Salvation Army maintained a well‑equipped hospital open to all classes.
facts.quote: The Salvation Army maintains a well-equipped hospital, which is open to all classes.
